application_type_full: Approval of details reserved by a condition (discharge)
decision_conditions: The drawings submitted and relied upon for determination of this application have resulted in fundamental changes to the proposal in comparison with the permitted scheme.  To enable access, a large ramp has also been introduced. To seek to balance the resultant changes, the overall dimensions of the stairs have increased, resulting in these being more prominent in proportion to the building and the streetscene.  The drawings submitted to support discharge of conditions constitute a material change to the approved plans and cannot be used to discharge the respective conditions.Insufficient information and information that is a material departure from the approved scheme (23/03512/FUL) has been provided to demonstrate compliance with the stated Conditions 3 and 11  to comply with policies CP30 and CP31 of the Enfield Core Strategy (2010), DMD6, DMD8, DMD44 and DMD37 of the Enfield Development Management Document (2014), the London Plan (2021) and the National Planning Policy Framework (2024).
